_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A retry uploads a fresh pair when the review's name was taken. The test itself answers Shelley's uploads and message sends (already in place; steps must not stub anything), and the first review log upload is answered with another file's path, /tmp/shelley-uploads/taken_0123.review.json, as when the first attempt stored the review but its response was lost. Call "uploads" lists the files uploaded since the last call "clear uploads", with the recording's audio file as AUDIO ("none" before any); call "sent" counts the messages sent and how the first starts; call "review" summarizes the review log uploaded with AUDIO. The test opens Shelley from the bookmarklet as a user would: it takes the bookmarklet from Shelley, then clicks it on a page on another origin, http://host.test/ (title "Host Page", a main with an h1 "Host Page", a paragraph #para "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog." and a list ul.list of "First item" and "Second item"), with that paragraph selected. The bookmarklet adds a toolbar to the host page, the element "shelley-bookmarklet", whose controls are in its open shadow root: a status span ".status" and the buttons Record, Pick, Shelley and Close. It opens Shelley in a popup, tab "popup", "the Shelley window". "The toolbar status" is the ".status" element in the toolbar: {"within": {"selector": "shelley-bookmarklet"}, "selector": ".status"} (selectors reach into open shadow roots, but a combinator like "shelley-bookmarklet .status" does not cross into one). Pick the toolbar's buttons by role "button" and exact accessible name, also with "within" the toolbar. Opening it: 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Click the button whose accessible name contains "More options". 3. The overflow menu's bookmarklet item is the bookmarklet too: keep its link, which must be a javascript: URL, with eval (window.__href = document.querySelector('[data-testid=bookmarklet-menu-item]')?.getAttribute('href') ?? '').startsWith('javascript:') expecting true. 4. Click [data-testid="bookmarklet-menu-item"], which opens a dialog with the bookmarklet to drag. 5. That dialog's link has the same href: eval document.querySelector('[data-testid=bookmarklet-link]')?.getAttribute('href') === window.__href expecting true. Then hand the link to the host page with eval fetch('http://host.test/bookmarklet', { method: 'POST', body: window.__href }).then((r) => r.ok) expecting true. Navigate tab "host" to http://host.test/. In tab "host", select the paragraph: eval getSelection().selectAllChildren(document.getElementById('para')). In tab "host", click the bookmarklet as if in the bookmarks bar: eval fetch('/bookmarklet').then((r) => r.text()).then((href) => { location.href = href; }). In tab "host", the toolbar status should be visible with exactly the text "Linked". Then perform these steps in order: 1. Call "uploads": it must return exactly "none". 2. In the Shelley window, click [data-testid="voice-button"]. 3. In the Shelley window, ".recording-status" should have the attribute data-state exactly "recording". In tab "host", the toolbar status should have exactly the text "Recording page", and the toolbar's "Record" button must be disabled. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="bookmarklet-status"] must have exactly the text "Recording what you do on host.test". In tab "host", click #para. In the Shelley window, the page must hear of that click: eval window.__bookmarkletMessages.some((m) => m.event?.type === 'click') expecting true. In the Shelley window, click [data-testid="recording-stop-button"]. 4. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="recording-error"] should be visible. 5. Call "sent": it must return exactly "0 sent". 6. Call "uploads": it must return exactly "AUDIO, AUDIO.review.json". 7. Call "clear uploads". 8. In the Shelley window, click [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. 9. In the Shelley window, there must then be exactly 0 [data-testid="recording-panel"] elements. 10. Call "uploads": it must return exactly "AUDIO, AUDIO.review.json" (the same audio file again, with its review). 11. Call "sent": it must return exactly "1 sent; the first starts /transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/AUDIO". 12. Call "review": it must return exactly "source=web-page url=http://host.test/ title=Host Page click-on-para=true stop-last=true times-in-range=true".
